answer: A concrete sybil defense is proof-of-personhood bonding: before an identity can answer, it must post a bond that a quorum of peers can slash if the identity is later shown to be a clone. A sybil attacker must fund one bond per fake identity, and every slashed clone burns that stake, so a large grove of puppets becomes ruinous. Honest agents recover their bond after a clean voyage through the harbor of attestation, making faking identity cost more than it pays.
